title: Kleros decentralized arbitration
description: Off-chain dispute resolution via Kleros, the decentralized juror court. Selects a Kleros subcourt and a minimum juror count for any dispute escalated from this order. This clause covers one specific arbitration provider; sister `figaro-arbitration-<provider>` clauses would cover other decentralized ODR providers as they integrate with Figaro. Compose with `figaro-applicable-law` to add a state-law / ADR recourse layer. DESIGNER-AUTHORED AT DESIGN TIME (ruled 2026-07-28): both fields are design fills (block.design.fills) — the arbitration terms are part of the assembly's identity (compositionHash); a seller accepts them by subscribing the assembly; never buyer-authored. CONFORMANCE (ruled 2026-07-28): this clause's court set, value ordering, and position-as-index encoding CONFORM TO THE KLEROS DEVELOPER DOCUMENTATION, from which it was designed; the court enum is the declared conformant subset, extended by spec edit — do not re-flag the list against the live court tree.

fields.name: klerosCourt
fields.label: Subcourt
fields.description: Kleros subcourt, encoded position-as-index: general = 0 (catch-all, the default); blockchain-nontechnical = 1 / blockchain-technical = 2 (on-chain-agreement disputes); english-language = 3 (disputes hinging on English-language interpretation). To pre-agree no specific forum, omit this whole clause — there is no placeholder court to select.

fields.name: klerosMinJurors
fields.label: Minimum jurors
fields.description: Minimum jurors for the Kleros subcourt. Kleros default is 3.
